lines.en: Squeak squeak, squish squish...
Sliding in the shadows, silently.

lines.zh: 饥饿时磨牙，发出咯咯声。
lines.en: Grinding teeth, making a creaking sound.
Licking paws, ready to act.
As night falls, it starts moving.
Chewing bones, to regain strength.
Tracking prey, eyes like torches.
Tail swaying, very alert.
Jumping and climbing, agile movements.
Eating rotten meat, waiting patiently.

lines.zh: 爪尖点着地面，一路小跑。
lines.en: My claws tap the ground as I trot along.

lines.zh: 拖着尾巴，在阴影里溜达。
lines.en: I drag my tail and prowl through the shadows.

lines.zh: 静悄悄地游荡，寻找机会。
lines.en: Silently wandering, looking for opportunities.
Chewing branches, sharpening claws.
Curling up, nocturnal habits.
Squeak, slowly chewing.
Staring at the player, watching for movements.
Tailing gently, relaxing.
Licking fur, keeping clean.
Observing surroundings, being vigilant.
Lying still, waiting for the right moment.
Scratching the ground, seeking comfort.

lines.zh: 抱着铁剑，翻来覆去地看。
lines.en: I hug an iron sword and turn it over and over.
I nudge an ender pearl into the corner.

lines.zh: 舔干净爪缝里的紫晶屑。
lines.en: I lick amethyst shards from between my claws.

lines.zh: 蹲在阴影里，眼珠转个不停。
lines.en: I crouch in the shade, eyes darting.
Fixing on the player, target acquired.
Eyes glowing, hungry for prey.
Ears up, listening for sounds.
Tail erect, ready to attack.
Body taut, ready for action.
Staring at the player, ready to pounce.
Snout sniffing, scent detected.
Eyes flickering, planning the move.
Creeping closer, stealthy approach.
Hissing, warning the player.

lines.zh: 紫光一晃，它盯上你腰间。
lines.en: A purple glimmer, and it eyes your belt.

lines.zh: 眼睛亮得像颗末影珍珠。
lines.en: Its eyes shine like an ender pearl.

lines.zh: 探头看你手里有没有铁剑。
lines.en: It stretches up to check you for an iron sword.

lines.zh: 从你脚边抬头，目光黏住。
lines.en: It looks up from your feet and its gaze sticks.
It tilts its head and listens to your steps.

lines.zh: 鼻尖一抽一抽，闻你身上的味。
lines.en: Its snout twitches, sniffing at you.

lines.zh: 盯着你的口袋，估价似的。
lines.en: It stares at your pockets as if pricing them.

lines.zh: 尾尖轻敲地面，眼睛不眨。
lines.en: Its tail taps the ground, eyes unblinking.

lines.zh: 虚弱了，我得去找点吃的。
lines.en: Weak, I need to find food.

lines.zh: 这破身体，怎么这么脆弱？
lines.en: This body, why so weak?
My strength is fading.
Need to rest now.

lines.zh: 受伤了，快找个藏身之处。
lines.en: Injured, find a hideout.
Need to heal this wound.
Need to recover from this.
Injured, need food.

lines.zh: 伤痕累累，找块地方养伤。
lines.en: Injured, need a place to heal.
Injured, need some food.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，眼中闪烁着邪恶的光芒。
lines.en: It stares at you with wicked eyes.

lines.zh: 它从阴影中现身，悄无声息。
lines.en: It appears from the shadows, silently.

lines.zh: 你手中的食物让它的眼中露出贪婪。
lines.en: Your food makes its eyes gleam with greed.

lines.zh: 它的触手伸向你，试图抓住你的手臂。
lines.en: Its tentacles reach for your arm.

lines.zh: 你扔出食物，它迅速扑过去。
lines.en: You throw food, and it lunges for it.

lines.zh: 它用触须缠住你，试图拖进阴影中。
lines.en: It wraps you in its tentacles.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同低吟，似乎在呼唤。
lines.en: Its voice is a low, calling whisper.

lines.zh: 你试图接近它，它却迅速后退。
lines.en: You approach, but it backs away.

lines.zh: 它的影子在墙上映出，令人不安。
lines.en: Its shadow casts an eerie shape on the wall.

lines.zh: 你扔出的东西，它一口就叼走。
lines.en: Whatever you toss, it snatches in one bite.

lines.zh: 它的速度让你难以躲避。
lines.en: Its speed makes it hard to avoid.

lines.zh: 它从你身后扑来，你猝不及防。
lines.en: It lunges at you from behind, catching you off guard.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的身体，感到一阵剧痛。
lines.en: You collide with its body, feeling pain.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠住了你的武器。
lines.en: Its tentacles grab your weapon.

lines.zh: 你和它在空中交缠，难以分开。
lines.en: You tangle in the air with it.

lines.zh: 它从你身边掠过，几乎触碰到你。
lines.en: It brushes past you, almost touching you.

lines.zh: 你与它在狭窄的空间中碰撞。
lines.en: You collide in a narrow space.

lines.zh: 它的影子在你面前突然出现。
lines.en: Its shadow appears in front of you suddenly.

lines.zh: 你试图推开它，但无法挣脱。
lines.en: You try to push it away, but can't.

lines.zh: 它的触手在空中乱舞，险些击中你。
lines.en: Its tentacles flail wildly, nearly hitting you.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的叫声，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It emits a low sound, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它在空中发出嘶嘶声，吸引异性。
lines.en: It hisses in the air, attracting a mate.

lines.zh: 它用触须缠绕同类，表达亲近。
lines.en: It wraps a mate in its tentacles.

lines.zh: 它从远处向你发出求偶的信号。
lines.en: It signals you from a distance to mate.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛里闪烁着求爱的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with the desire to mate.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，试图嗅探你的气息。
lines.en: It approaches, trying to scent you.

lines.zh: 它的触须轻触你的身体，示意接近。
lines.en: Its tentacles touch your body, signaling approach.

lines.zh: 它在空中做出求偶的动作。
lines.en: It performs a mating gesture in the air.

lines.zh: 它用触须轻轻摩擦你的皮肤。
lines.en: It gently rubs its tentacles against your skin.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁，似乎在等待。
lines.en: Its eyes flash in the dark, waiting.

lines.zh: 它敏捷地偷走了你的剑。
lines.en: It sneakily snatched your sword.

lines.zh: 它蜷缩成一团，准备吃掉你。
lines.en: It curls up, ready to devour you.

lines.zh: 它舔着嘴唇，准备啃骨头。
lines.en: It licks its lips, ready to gnaw on bones.

lines.zh: 它用爪子在你身上挠来挠去。
lines.en: It scratches at you with its claws.
Its gaze is filled with greed.

lines.zh: 它敏捷地跳向你的背部。
lines.en: It leaps onto your back.
It gnaws on rotting flesh.

lines.zh: 它的小眼睛闪烁着邪恶的光芒。
lines.en: Its small eyes glint with malice.
It gnaws on the bones on the ground.
It suddenly appears from the shadows.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地接近你的脚步。
lines.en: It approaches you silently.
It locks on to you, creeping closer.

lines.zh: 它用锐利的目光盯着你。
lines.en: It fixes you in its sharp gaze.

lines.zh: 它悄悄地跟踪着你的行踪。
lines.en: It trails your movements silently.

lines.zh: 你腰间的铁剑，我看了三眼。
lines.en: Three glances at the iron sword on your belt.

lines.zh: 它紧盯着你的每一个动作。
lines.en: It watches every move you make.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地靠近你的藏身处。
lines.en: It approaches your hiding place silently.

lines.zh: 它潜伏在你周围，伺机而动。
lines.en: It lurks around you, waiting for an opening.

lines.zh: 它紧紧追踪着你的气息。
lines.en: It follows your scent closely.
It begins to creep closer to you.

lines.zh: 它盯上了你腰间的铁剑。
lines.en: It has set its sights on your iron sword.

lines.zh: 末影珍珠的味道，它闻到了。
lines.en: It caught the scent of an ender pearl.

lines.zh: 你背着包，它算着怎么下手。
lines.en: You carry a pack, and it plans its move.

lines.zh: 影子一动，它已经绕到背后。
lines.en: A shadow shifts, and it is already behind you.
It quietly counts how many steps you take.
What you hold now belongs to it.
It suddenly lunges at you.

lines.zh: 它用尖锐的牙齿咬向你。
lines.en: It bites you with its sharp teeth.
It claws at your head.
It rips your arm off.
It tries to bite your throat off.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的腿，试图拖走你。
lines.en: It bites your leg, trying to drag you away.
It claws at your face.
It bites your abdomen.

lines.zh: 它试图用尖牙撕裂你的皮肤。
lines.en: It tries to tear your skin with its sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它用爪子按住你，防止你逃跑。
lines.en: It holds you down with its claws to prevent your escape.

lines.zh: 它伏低身子，爪尖抠着地。
lines.en: It lowers itself, claws digging in.
It curls up, and purple light flickers.
Tail rigid, it is ready to pounce.
It circles you, hunting for an opening.
It skims the ground, closer and closer.
It fixes on your wrist.

lines.zh: 呼吸压得很轻，怕你听见。
lines.en: Its breath is hushed so you will not hear.
It has chosen your back.
Sharp claws slice the air.
One hook of my claw, escape route already planned.

lines.zh: 细长的尾巴在身侧摆动。
lines.en: Its long tail sways beside it.

lines.zh: 紫色的音，从喉咙里滑出来。
lines.en: A purple note slides out of my throat.
Sharp teeth are bared.
Easily dodges your attacks.
Hooks you with its claws.
Whips its tail across your back.
Flies at your throat.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中带着死亡的威胁。
lines.en: Hisssssss with a deathly threat.
One claw swipe, and it snatches and runs.
It bites down on your fingers.
It leaps up and claws your belt.
Its teeth are small but they bite slyly.
A purple flash, and your thing is gone.
It whips your legs with its tail.
Emerges silently from the shadows.
Lurks in dark corners.

lines.zh: 在末影珍珠的光芒中现身。
lines.en: Appears in the light of an ender pearl.
Flickers in and out of the fog.
Appears suddenly as you pass by.

lines.zh: 在密林深处静静地等待。
lines.en: Waits quietly in the depths of the forest.

lines.zh: 在你毫无防备时突然出现。
lines.en: Appears when you are unprepared.
Wanders in dark caves.
Crawls through thick vines.

lines.zh: 在荒废的遗迹中静静潜伏。
lines.en: Lurks quietly in abandoned ruins.

lines.zh: 末影珍珠的光里，它成形了。
lines.en: It forms inside the light of an ender pearl.

lines.zh: 从紫色的裂缝里钻出来。
lines.en: It crawls out of a violet rift.

lines.zh: 你打开箱子，它已在里面。
lines.en: You open the chest, and it is already inside.
The shadows gain two small lamps.
It climbs out along the end stone.
It lifts its head from a pile of bones.

lines.zh: 深渊一暗，它出现在角落。
lines.en: The abyss darkens, and it appears in the corner.
Where amethyst shards fall, it shows itself.
Burned by fire, get out!
Fell into a pit, hurts!
Drowned, swim!
Exploded, hide.
Hit by an arrow, run!
Magical attack, hide.
Hungry, need food.
Lightning hit, avoid!
Dropped into the void, end.
